## About SiteVue

SiteVue is a Nashville-area startup founded in August 2025 by Andrew Jebasingh that uses AI-powered video analytics and smart cameras to monitor workforce productivity and safety in factories, warehouses and construction sites. Its computer-vision platform interprets activity on the floor in real time and surfaces cycle-time, downtime and near-miss metrics through dashboards aimed at operations leaders.⁠​​‌‌​​‌​​​‌‌​​​​​​‌‌​​‌​​​‌‌​‌‌​​​‌​‌‌​‌​​‌‌​​​‌​​‌‌​​​‌​​‌​‌‌​‌​​‌‌​​​‌​​‌‌​​​​​‌‌‌‌‌​​​​‌‌​​‌‌​‌‌​​‌​‌​‌‌​​‌​​​‌‌​​‌​​​​‌‌​​‌‌​​‌‌​​‌‌​​‌‌​​‌​​​‌‌​​​​​‌‌‌‌‌​​​​‌​‌‌​‌​‌‌‌‌‌​​​‌‌​​​​‌​​‌‌​‌​‌​​‌‌‌​​​​​‌‌​​‌​​​‌‌​‌‌​​​‌‌‌​​‌​​‌‌‌​​​​​‌‌​‌​​​‌‌​​​​‌​‌‌​​​​‌​​‌‌​‌​​​‌‌​​​‌‌​​‌‌​​‌​​​‌‌‌​​​​​‌‌‌​​‌​​‌‌​​‌​​​‌​‌‌​‌​‌​​‌​​‌​‌​​​​​‌​‌​​​‌​​⁠
